en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Zaydan and `Ali b. al-`Abbas al-Bujliyan narrated to us. They said: Abu Kurayb narrated to us. He said: Mu`awiya b. Hisham narrated to us. He said: Shayban narrated to us from `Ikrama from Ibn `Abbas.
He said: A man said: O Messenger of Allah! Greying has hastened to you. He said: [Surat] Hud, al-Waq`ia, al-Mursalat, and `amma yatasa’alun have greyed me.
